language: Kotlin JVM mod (content registered in code; HJSON content removed)
changelog: Phase 7: v155.4 compatibility, full Kotlin content registration, and tag-driven GitHub Release automation
goal: A compact Kotlin Mindustry mod that uses crystal logistics as a base, then grows into code-driven mechanics instead of HJSON reskins

power.crystal-power-node: PowerNode - compact local crystal grid connector

converted_v1.6: all items/liquids/status/blocks moved from HJSON into Kotlin content registries
build target adapted to Mindustry v155.4
GitHub Actions now builds deploy jar with Android merge and publishes tagged releases automatically
kt_mod_real_roadmap: custom CrystalResonatorBlock: adjacency-based resonance network, not another GenericCrafter clone
crystal power instability: overload, discharge, and grid-side risk/reward mechanics
crystal-fluid thermal loop: coolant quality and heat state affect crafting/turret behavior
scripted campaign/research hooks that teach the chain through events instead of flat tech-tree spam
custom draw/effect layer for crystal charge level so visuals reflect runtime state
unique defensive identity: walls store incoming energy and retaliate based on accumulated charge
avoid same-type bloat: every added block must introduce a new decision, not only larger numbers

crystal_drill.reason: tier 4 drillTime 320 was too slow vs industrial-drill (tier 6, 200). Raised tier to 5, reduced time, increased health/power to match size 3 tier-5 range

crystal_smelter.reason: Old recipe too cheap. New ratio 2:3 mirrors plastanium/poly ratio. Longer craft time balances throughput

crystal_alloy.reason: hardness 0 means no drill can mine it. Set to 1 so all drills can process

crystal_fluid.reason: 1.8 too close to cryofluid(1.9). 1.5 positions it as mid-tier coolant. Higher viscosity gives better flow control feel

crystal.reason: tier 4 drill can barely mine. Set hardness 4 for proper tier match
